description:
A JUnit Platform LauncherSessionListener that hosts dev services for a test run (spec
        2026-09-24-devservices-visibility-run-tests §7). An application adds this module test-scoped, next to
        the providers it wants; it brings vidocq-runtime-devservices-extension transitively. Must ship as its
        own jar — spec §7.1's spike proved that a listener compiled into an application's own test sources is
        folded by Surefire's module-path patching into the application's named module, where ServiceLoader can
        no longer see its META-INF/services entry.
